card.name: Start of a new text section
card.fires_on: Boundary spots where a new section starts, such as the gap or dash after a dictionary source title or the space after a page menu. Also fires on 'general' or 'widespread' after 'no' or 'a' in the middle of a sentence.

modes.label: Dictionary entry start
modes.description: The space or dash right after a dictionary source name, just before the definition.

modes.label: Page break gaps
modes.description: A space or full stop where web page menu or editing text ends and body text begins.

modes.label: Adjective before agreement
modes.description: The word 'general' after 'There is no' in a treatment sentence.
modes.example: There is no<< general>> agreement about specific pharmacological treatment regimens
